title: Controller Spec
description: AI generator output. Describes an opinionated control surface for a scene's parameter catalog. The renderer turns this into a live UI; control inputs write back to TD via the WebSocket DAT.

scene_id.description: Matches the catalog the spec was generated from.

rationale.description: Free-text: why this layout. Useful for debugging the prompt; not rendered.

controls.description: Hard cap of 12 — 'no thinking' thesis breaks at more.

layout.description: Optional 2D layout: array of rows, each row an array of control ids. Renderer falls back to a flat grid if absent.

type.description: knob/slider for floats. toggle for bool. button for pulse. macro modulates multiple params with a single input.

label.description: Human-readable name shown on the control.

bind.description: Required for knob/slider/toggle/button. Forbidden for macro (use `macro_bindings` instead).

macro_bindings.description: Required for macro. List of params modulated by this control's 0..1 input.

path.description: Must match a parameter `path` in the catalog the spec was generated from.

param_type.description: Echoed from the catalog. Renderer uses this to coerce the outgoing value.

min.description: Optional override of the catalog range (e.g. softer slider). Must stay within the catalog's hard range.

curve.description: Maps the control's 0..1 input to the param range. exp for things like intensity/loudness where small movement at low values matters more.

macro_binding.description: One leg of a macro: as the macro input goes 0..1, this param sweeps from `from` to `to`.
